notes:
Summary: ArchiveWave runs a large media archive (news transcripts, video OCR, wire copy). Primary objective is a newsroom search product for journalists + internal compliance search. Focus: embeddings + reranker pipeline to improve precision on long-document queries.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-11-18: Intro call (AE Alyssa) — high-level use-case, ingest cadence, rough scale numbers.
- 2025-12-05: Architecture sync (SE Marcus) — discussed FAISS vs HNSW, hybrid BM25 + dense.
- 2026-01-22: Security questionnaire submitted; on-prem options flagged.
- 2026-02-15: Demo (recorded: ff_2026-02-15_ArchiveWave_demo). Showed current Elastic + custom reranker.
- 2026-02-28: Security deep-dive (ff_2026-02-28_security_qna). KMS and audit log questions outstanding.
- 2026-03-03: Pricing follow-up; asked for Dedicated sizing recommendation.

Technical constraints & numbers (customer-provided):
- Corpus: ~15M documents (mixed: long-form articles, transcripts, OCRed images). Average raw length ~6k-10k tokens.
- Query load: peak 250 qps search endpoints (newsroom), baseline 40 qps.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for interactive search; p95 < 200ms targeted for autocomplete-like queries.
- Cost sensitivity: target $0.01-0.03 per search (end-to-end) given editorial budget.
- Current stack: Elastic for indexing + custom cross-encoder reranker (expensive) used during peak only.

Chunking strategy discussion notes:
- Prefer semantic chunking where possible (paragraph boundaries + speaker turns) to preserve context for reranker.
- Prototype: fixed 1024-token chunks with 20% overlap for transcripts; use sentence-boundary-aware tokenizer to avoid splits in middle of captions.
- Retain chunk metadata: source_id, timecode, OCR-confidence, original paragraph id. Store embedding per chunk and a lightweight BM25 index for fallback.
- De-duplication: aggressive fingerprinting to collapse near-duplicate captions (news wires).
- Recombine strategy for long hits: post-retrieval passage-aggregation to present contiguous ranges to the user.

Reranker & retrieval tuning notes:
- Baseline plan: two-stage pipeline = dense retriever (FAISS/HNSW) top-200 -> lightweight bi-encoder re-score top-50 -> cross-encoder rerank top-10 for final results during business hours.
- Evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs: cross-encoder only on top-10 reduces expense; consider distilling cross-encoder to a 2-3x cheaper model for most queries.
- Negative sampling: mix hard negatives from BM25 + in-batch negatives; augment with temporal negatives for news freshness.
- Evaluation metrics: MRR@10, nDCG@10, P@1 for journalist queries, plus latency & cost per query.
- Reranker tuning: learning-to-rank objective with pairwise margin, calibrate softmax temperature to avoid overconfidence on short snippets.
- Consider LambdaMART offline for feature-rich re-ranking when embeddings ambiguous.

Indexing & scale operations:
- Bulk ingest rate requirement: can’t block newsroom; need streaming + batch backfill. Aim: sustained 5k chunks/sec ingest for initial migration.
- Storage: estimate 15M docs -> ~120M chunks (with 1k average chunk size) — customer to confirm. Need recommendation on sharding/replication for Dedicated clusters.
- Cache opportunities: aggressive prefix caching for recurring queries (top queries are highly skewed).

Performance/cost targets and experiments requested:
- Run A/B: full cross-encoder vs distilled cross-encoder on p95 latency and editorial precision over a 2-week window.
- Measure cost-per-query (end-to-end) including retrieval, rerank, and aggregation. Target <$0.03.
- Quantization experiments: 8-bit inference for reranker; evaluate quality drop.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must support company-controlled keys (KMS/HSM) or deploy Private with customer-managed key.
- Data residency: EU for some feeds; need multi-region routing.
- Audit logs and token-level tracing required for compliance audits.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- CTO: "Precision > 1st page matters — a bad hit wastes journalist time and undermines trust."
- Head of Search: "We can tolerate occasional latency spikes during nightly backfills, but daytime p95 must be tight."

POC scope requested by customer:
- Ingest 1M sample chunks (representative mix).
- Run retrieval + top-10 cross-encoder rerank; deliver metrics (MRR, nDCG, latency p50/p95, cost per query).
- Show deployment options: Dedicated sizing + Private bundle with KMS.

Next steps (short):
- Finalize POC contract and NDAs (Alyssa).
- Provide Dedicated node sizing guidance and preliminary cost estimate (Marcus).
- Security team to triage key custody request (Priya).
- Customer to provide 1M sample set + relevance annotation (small editorial team).

Open questions / blockers (quick list):
- Exact chunk count after semantic chunking (customer to confirm) — impacts index SLOs.
- Can we support cross-region private control plane for EU residency?
- Budget window: procurement reviews in May; need formal proposal by 2026-05-15.

Related artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive (links above); Jira INF-7643 covers Dedicated sizing; SEC-1120 tracks KMS discussion.
